stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023 entering class; exact counts). No Common Data Set was found on Medgar Evers' institutional research page (it lists fact sheets and dashboards only), so no international split, GPA or residency data; international applicant counts are not published. College Navigator fall 2024: 12,015 applicants, 86% admitted, 6% of admits enrolled (admit counts not shown). SAT percentiles are for only 20 enrolled students (3%) who submitted SAT in fall 2024, so they are a thin sample. Mixed associate/bachelor's college: IPEDS counts include associate-degree applicants.

cds_test_policy.notes: College Navigator: first-year applicants can choose whether to submit SAT/ACT through the spring 2027 semester (CUNY-wide test-optional policy).

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition includes required fees; off-campus food and housing (Medgar Evers has no campus housing); total is the out-of-state off-campus figure (in-state off-campus $37,328). F-1/J-1 students pay the New York State non-resident rate (CUNY). CUNY's 2026-27 rates: $620 per credit non-resident, $3,465 per semester NYS resident full-time (12+ credits) plus fees.
